note: Buy/purchase same event; 'purchase' is more formal register than 'buy'.
Give up/abandon same event; phrasal 'give up' is more informal than 'abandon'.
Put off/postpone same event; 'put off' is informal, 'postpone' formal.
Light-verb 'give an answer to' vs 'answer'; same event, more formal/indirect phrasing.
Idiom 'kick the bucket' = die; strong informal/humorous register lost if collapsed.
Light-verb 'take a walk' = 'walk'; implies leisure nuance bare verb lacks.
'Exhausted' may exceed 'very tired' in intensity; degree-modifier structure lost either way.
